updates.finding: Follow-on reporting materially expands the previously public three-condition summary. Al Jazeera reports Rezaei publicly specified six conditions: end the war on all fronts (especially Lebanon); release frozen Iranian funds; end the naval blockade on Iranian ports; end U.S. interference in Iran's internal affairs; end U.S. cooperation with opponents of Iran's revolution; and end all U.S. attacks on Iranian territory. Rezaei separately says Iran conveyed seven conditions, leaving one condition undisclosed in the public list.
updates.status: SUPPORTED AS IRANIAN STATED POSITION; ONE OF SEVEN CONDITIONS STILL UNDISCLOSED
updates.drawer_effect: Supersede prior wording that only three conditions were publicly known. Preserve earlier reporting as statement-time state; current public list is six named conditions plus one undisclosed condition.

updates.update_type: new claim / sequencing clarification linked to Hormuz diplomacy drawer
updates.finding: Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said there would be no return to the previous negotiations or reopening of the Strait of Hormuz until Iran's conditions are met, Iranian rights recognized, and U.S. commitments fulfilled. This is materially stronger sequencing language than merely describing settlement conditions and should be preserved as an Iranian official position, not as an agreed bilateral term.
updates.status: SUPPORTED AS CLAIMANT POSITION; NOT AGREED TERMS
updates.drawer_effect: Update the Hormuz/negotiation drawer: Iranian public messaging now explicitly links reopening/return to negotiations to prior fulfillment of its conditions. Do not retroactively attribute this exact sequencing to Rezaei's earlier three-condition formulation.

updates.finding: Iran's military central command said it had information that a major new U.S./allied attack was being prepared and warned that any such attack would trigger sustained retaliation against U.S. bases and interests; U.S. regional allies would be treated as parties to the conflict. Reuters reported no elaboration or independent evidence supporting Iran's claimed foreknowledge. The U.S. State Department separately issued a security alert warning of possible unforeseen regional escalation, flight cancellations and airspace closures; this does not independently validate Iran's intelligence claim.
updates.drawer_effect: Add to escalation/claims drawer with strict separation between Iranian claimed intelligence, Iranian declared retaliation policy, and independent U.S. precautionary alert.

updates.finding: Reuters identified the visible plume as rising from the fuel-storage area at King Khalid International Airport. On Sep. 20 Saudi equities closed 0.3% lower and Qatar 1.1% lower amid the Houthi attack claims and regional risk. This adds market impact and location specificity but does not resolve weapon-to-damage attribution or independently establish the Houthi Yanbu BDA claim.
updates.status: VISIBLE AIRPORT FUEL-AREA FIRE SUPPORTED; CAUSAL ATTRIBUTION STILL UNRESOLVED
updates.drawer_effect: Update existing Riyadh event rather than create a duplicate. Preserve Saudi interception account and Houthi strike claims separately from observed damage.
